scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Greetings, adventurer.
I'm a member of the Hypnotist
Academy sent here to Izlude
to provide Skill Reset services
to certain First Class characters for a really good price: free!
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
你好，冒險者。
我是催眠師學院派到依斯魯得島的成員，
為特定一轉職業提供技能重置服務，
而且價格非常優惠：免費！

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Although I offer unlimited
stat/skill resets for now, I have
two conditions that must be
fulfilled. First, you must be
lower than ^FF0000Base Level 50^000000.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
雖然目前我提供無限次的屬性/技能重置，
但有兩個條件必須滿足。
首先，你的^FF0000基礎等級^000000必須低於50級。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Second, you must be a
^FF0000Swordman, Acolyte, Mage,
Thief, Archer, Merchant,
Taekwon Boy, or Taekwon Girl,
Gunslinger and Ninja^000000
Job character to qualify.
Now, do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
其次，你必須是以下職業之一：
^FF0000劍士、服事、魔法師、盜賊、弓箭手、商人、
跆拳男孩、跆拳女孩、神槍手或忍者^000000。
請問你有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text: ^FF0000Stat/Skill Reset?
scripts.translation: ^FF0000屬性/技能重置？

scripts.text: Reset stats
scripts.translation: 重置屬性

scripts.text: Reset skills^000000
Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Stat/Skill Resets allow adventuers
to redistribute their Skill
Points if they are unhappy
with their current skills.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
屬性/技能重置允許冒險者重新分配技能點，
如果你不滿意當前的技能配置。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Before proceeding with
a Stat/Skill Reset, you must
reduce all of the weight
of all carried items on your
character to 0. You can put
extra items in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
在進行屬性/技能重置之前，
你必須將角色身上所有攜帶物品的重量減至0。
你可以將多餘的物品存入卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Ah, it's also important
to remove your ^FF0000Pushcart^000000
if you have one equipped.
Otherwise, hypnosis won't
work, or will backfire...
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
啊，如果你裝備了^FF0000手推車^000000，
也請務必將其卸下。
否則，催眠可能無效，或者產生反效果...

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Are you sure that you
want to proceed with
my ^FF0000{0} Reset^000000 service?
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
你確定要使用我的^FF0000{0}重置^000000服務嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Thank you, and good
luck on your adventures.
Please travel in safety~
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
謝謝，祝你在冒險中好運。
請一路平安~

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Oh! Please remove your
Pushcart before proceeding
with the {0} Reset service.
Thanks for cooperating~
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
哦！請先卸下你的手推車，
然後再進行{0}重置服務。
謝謝配合~

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
If you're here for my {0}
Reset service, please
remember that you can't
reset your {1}s until the
^FF0000weight of your carried items in
your Inventory is reduced to 0^000000.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
如果你是為了我的{0}重置服務而來，
請記住，在^FF0000將背包中攜帶物品的重量減至0^000000之前，
你無法重置你的{1}。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Why don't you place your
things into the Kafra Storage
for now? That way, you can
safely keep all of your goods.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
你為什麼不先把東西放進卡普拉倉庫呢？
這樣你可以安全地保管所有物品。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
I'm sorry, but characters
with Base Levels higher
than 50 are ineligible for the
{0} Reset service I provide.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
很抱歉，基礎等級高於50級的角色
不符合我提供的{0}重置服務資格。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Thank you for using
my {0} Redistribution
services. Oh, and best
of luck to you on your
travels, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
感謝使用我的{0}重置服務。
哦，祝你在旅途中好運，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
I'm sorry, but your
Job Class doesn't qualify
for the {0} Reset service
that I provide. I can only
offer {1} Resets to the
following Jobs...
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
很抱歉，你的職業不符合
我提供的{0}重置服務資格。
我只能為以下職業提供{1}重置...

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
^FF0000Swordman, Acolyte,
Mage, Thief, Archer,
Merchant, Taekwon
Boy, Taekwon Girl,
Gunslinder and Ninja^000000.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
^FF0000劍士、服事、魔法師、盜賊、弓箭手、商人、
跆拳男孩、跆拳女孩、神槍手和忍者^000000。
